_about: Hand-researched links from permittee LLCs to the companies behind them. Each link needs evidence that ties back to the permit (its mailing address, site name or location). 'permit' evidence is filled in from the site's own permit text by the loader. Claims are paraphrased; no source text is copied. Aggregator directories (baxtel, datacentermap, datacenterhawk, cleanview) are used only as corroboration. Researched 2026-10-12.
